summary: refactor(queue-ticket): address shotgun surgery on inputs variable

delivery.outcome: Shotgun surgery on 'inputs' removed: _ticket_inputs is the single binding site; request building moved to _build_llm_request/_build_api_request/_build_taskand_request taking inputs as a parameter.
nonGoals: Changing request shapes, defaults, or env fallbacks

architecture.decision: Public ticket_*_request functions delegate to private builders that receive the extracted inputs dict; _ticket_inputs is the only place binding ticket['inputs'].
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch; pure function-level refactor in one module.

validation.evidence: Queue ticket parsing and request building semantics preserved.
